description: Generate contour lines from a Digital Terrain Model in TopoCal. TopoCal is open with a pre-saved project containing 204 survey points and a DTM (triangulated terrain mesh) already built from those points. The survey area covers the Colorado foothills with elevations from approximately 1718m to 2458m. Generate contour lines at 25-meter intervals. In TopoCal's Spanish menu interface: look for the 'Curvas de nivel' menu (contour lines) and select the option to calculate or generate contour lines ('Calcular curvas de nivel' or similar). Set the contour interval to 25 meters when prompted. After generation, contour lines should appear overlaid on the terrain mesh in the drawing area.
